{{Quote|To crack the door to Belsavis, the Emperor has directed his guardsmen to coordinate extractions from the prison planet. A clever cover.|[[Servant One]], a member of the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''invasion of Belsavis''', also known as the '''Belsavis prison break''', was a battle that occurred during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] around [[3640 BBY]] after the Empire discovered the location of the [[Belsavis prison]], a top-secret Republic penal colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. A small strike team followed by [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] saw the Republic prison heavily damaged, and the Empire incited riots throughout the complex as they worked to free important prisoners such as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]]. Unbeknownst to the Empire, the attack on Belsavis was a distraction to hide the efforts of [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]], who sought to destroy the entire world for the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] but was stopped by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]].

Chaos raged in the [[Minimum Security Section|Minimum]], [[High Security Section|High]], and [[Maximum Security Section]]s of the prison colony, but as Imperial forces penetrated [[the Tomb]]—the ancient prison complex upon which the Republic facility was built—the battle changed. In their search for the Dread Masters and their efforts to sow chaos, Imperial forces broke open a number of sealed vaults, unleashing horrors that had been locked away by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] who had built the Tomb. The violent [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] overwhelmed much of the Imperial forces in the Tomb, though the Dread Masters were successfully extracted and the Republic stopped the Esh-kha from releasing an entity known as the [[World Razer]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Empire only found this forgotten world when I called them—on the transmitter abandoned millennia ago by the creators of Belsavis.|Ivory|<ref name="Twenty to Life">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Twenty to Life|Belsavis}}</ref>}}
The conflict on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] centered around the [[Belsavis prison]], a prison colony run by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Belsavis" /> that was constructed atop an even older prison—[[the Tomb]], built thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="The Tomb">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Tomb}}</ref> The existence of the Tomb was discovered by the Republic around [[3691 BBY]], and upon discovering the horrors contained within the ancient Rakatan vaults, the Republic established their own prison atop the Tomb. During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the population of Belsavis prison swelled with captured [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], and criminals. [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], the intelligence arm of the Sith Empire, spent years searching for the prison as rumors of its existence spread.<ref name="Holonet" />

The Empire first learned of the Belsavis prison's location around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> when the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] inmate [[Ivory]]<ref name="Twenty to Life" /> used a subspace transmitter, one that he had built over the last few decades<ref name="A Belsavis Welcome" /> using Rakata technology, to contact the Empire.<ref name="Twenty to Life" /> IvoryAround a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the Empire learned about the complex,<ref name="Breakout">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Breakout|Belsavis}}</ref> during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the Republic, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] dispatched his agents throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to commit genocide—the Emperor planned to use a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|Sith ritual]] to consume all life in the galaxy, and his ritual required a sacrifice on a planetary scale. The Emperor's servants influenced the Empire to attack Belsavis, thus providing a distraction for [[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]] [[Krannus]] and his [[Krannus's death cult|death cult]] to carry out their plans to destroy the planet.<ref name="Anarchy" />

==The battle==
===Initial strikes===
{{Quote|A few days ago, our prison here was breached. An Imperial air strike, apparently coordinated with a massive prison break within. The planet is in chaos. Shock troops are arriving daily to contain it.|Senator Bevara Dodonna|<ref name="Most Wanted" />}}
The Empire's attack on Belsavis came as a complete surprise to the Republic, which were unaware of Ivory's message to the Empire and also believed that the facility was not a prime military target. The Empire began their invasion by landing a small team of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and elite [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] onto the surface, and the strike force was tasked with freeing as many prisoners as possible to throw the prison into chaos. Some of the freed prisoners, a large number of whom were Imperial prisoners of war, joined the Imperial forces, while the remainder joined the riots and attacked everyone. As the Republic security forces struggled to respond,<ref name="Belsavis Prison Break">{{TORcite|type=codex|Belsavis Prison Break}}</ref> the Empire converted the remains of a camp used by early Republic explorers into a [[Imperial Lodgement|fortified lodgement]] in the prison's [[Minimum Security Section]].<ref name="Minimum Security Section">{{TORcite|type=codex|Minimum Security Section}}</ref> and brought in a mobile battle platform, [[Proculus Station]], into the planet's orbit.<ref name="Belsavis Prison Break" /> From their new ground base, Imperial forces made surgical strikes to breach cell blocks and destroy dividing walls; numerous barrier walls in the Minimum Security Section had massive holes torn in to them by explosives,<ref name="Minimum Security Section" /> and Imperial bombardment wreaked further havoc.<ref name="Most Wanted" /> The prison armories were also blown open by Imperial forces, allowing the rioters access to weaponry that put them on equal footing with the guards.<ref name="A Belsavis Welcome" />

The Republic withdrew many of the prison guards and their families to the complex's security and administrative centers;<ref name="Minimum Security Section" /> due to their focus on the prisoners and not the invaders, the Republic was unable to drive off the small number of Imperial forces before enemy reinforcements arrived.<ref name="Belsavis Prison Break" /> The [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] soon arrived to support the prison security forces, which were struggling to contain the prisoners under the leadership of [[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Playt]], but it was some time before the Republic could mobilize significant forces to counter the Imperials.<ref name="A Belsavis Welcome" /> Many of the civilians were hidden in the [[Prisoner Intake]] yards, and after [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Mark Vempor]] was able to acquire transport to evacuate the guards' families and the other civilians, Republic forces were able to clear a path for the civilians to reach the [[Perimeter Patrol Command Post]].<ref name="Evacuation">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Evacuation|Belsavis}}</ref>

Meanwhile, the Empire began recruiting forces from the Belsavis prisoners, taking Imperial prisoners of war as well as violent criminals willing to serve.<ref name="Belsavis Prison Break" /> The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Enna Tabord]] arrived on Belsavis around the time of the invasion; she had been tasked with scouting the area and locating Executor Krannus in advance of the arrival of the [[Hero of Tython]], a powerful Jedi Knight who was rushing to Belsavis to stop Krannus's plans. However, she was overpowered and fatally injured while out scouting, and barely managed to reach a guardpost and inform the criminal-turned-guard [[Pak Taldine]] about spotting Krannus's forces near the [[South Power Generator Facility|Minimum Security power generators]].<ref name="Anarchy" /> Early in the invasion, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rago/Legends|Rago's]] attempts to retrieve the Belsavis prison records from the [[Detainee Processing Center]] was foiled when the New Men, a cult of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] criminals, took control of the facility. When Imperial reinforcements finally pushed through the New Men and a small group of Republic soldiers who sought to stop the Imperials from accessing the records, the Empire was able to download the prison records and locate persons of interest throughout the complex.<ref name="A Pertinent Find" />

The primary objective of the Imperial forces, under the leadership of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Calum]] of the [[Imperial Guard]], was to free the [[Dread Masters]]—six powerful Sith Lords who were [[Capture of the Dread Masters|captured]] during the last war. Five [[Special Operations Group]]s were deployed to penetrate deeper into the prison; [[Special Operations Group Five]], under the command of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Medechas]], was tasked with securing the Minimum Security Section. However, Republic forces anticipated the Empire's target and relocated the Dread Masters to the Tomb.<ref name="Riot on Belsavis" /> When Imperial forces breached the [[High Security Section]] to the west, [[Special Operations Group Four]] established an [[Imperial Command Post]] in the ruins of a damaged Republic watchtower,<ref name="Operations Group Four" /> and the three other groups continued onward into the [[Maximum Security Section]]. However, when the Imperial forces reached the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]]—the first level of the Rakatan prison—beyond Maximum Security, their efforts to breach the Rakatan vaults had dire consequences. While [[Special Operations Group One|Groups One]] and [[Special Operations Group Two|Two]] moved onward to locate the Dread Masters in the Tomb, [[Special Operations Group Three|Group Three]] cracked open a number of vaults and released the [[Esh-kha]], a violent [[Species/Legends|species]] of warriors that had been entombed within Belsavis by the Rakata. The Esh-kha overran the Imperial forces and spilled out into both Maximum Security and the Tomb, and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Grang]] withdrew the remains of Group Three to the [[Imperial frontline camp]] in Maximum Security.<ref name="Esh-kha Containment" />

===Riots and chaos===
{{Quote|We just unleashed enough vicious alien prisoners to keep the Republic busy for months. Then we hit a hiccup. The alien gangs went berserk, attacking Imperial and Republic alike. We need to restore order, ASAP.|Captain Vandorn|<ref name="TOR" />}}
During this [[Time/Legends|time]], the Imperial agent [[Feldon (Human)|Feldon]] made contact with [[Nyranos]], the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] leader of the prisoners known as the [[Condemned]].<ref name="Riot in the Warden's Station" /> The Condemned were the Belsavis-born descendants of earlier prisoners, but Warden Playt had refused to allow them to leave Belsavis despite never being sentenced there. Under Feldon's direction, the Condemned attacked the [[Prison Command Center]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Warden Playt, though his assistant [[Graal]] survived and became the new warden.<ref name="A Belsavis Welcome" /> Republic forces were able to restore the generators powering the command center's shields, and when the Condemned raided a nearby armory for shield-disrupting [[magnetar rifle]]s, military and security forces eliminated the Condemned there before they could attack the command center again.<ref name="Magnetar Rifles">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Magnetar Rifles|Belsavis}}</ref> A pre-emptory strike against the Condemned stopped the criminals' plans to use a [[neural disruptor]] against prison guards,<ref name="Crisis Prevention">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Crisis Prevention|Belsavis}}</ref> but the Condemned overran the command center with Imperial aid.<ref name="Riot in the Warden's Station" />

{{GameLS}}
However, Nyranos ended his agreement with Feldon upon taking the command center, as he only wished to negotiate with Warden Graal; an angered Feldon and several Condemned traitors turned against Nyranos but were killed. Despite Graal's anger about Playt's death, Nyranos's requests of farmlands and supplies for his people were met by the Republic, and the Condemned withdrew from the command center.<ref name="Riot in the Warden's Station" />
{{EndGame}}

{{GameDS}}
Elsewhere in the Minimum Security, the efforts of Marshal [[Ellis Ruger]], an offworld enforcer brought in by Warden Playt, began to regain a semblance of control in areas of the Minimum Security Section. As a result, Lord Medechas's forces attacked and destroyed many of Ruger's warden droids in order to rally the rioters' enthusiasm.<ref name="Metal Militia">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Metal Militia|Belsavis}}</ref> Medechas's forces also overran the [[Carbonite Prisoner Storage]], killing the [[Crisis Response Unit]] guarding it and releasing numerous psychotic prisoners to fuel the riot.<ref name="The Carbon Gallery" /> Ruger was protected by force fields in [[Republic Guardpost Delta]], but the Empire recovered the key to Ruger's guard station from [[Gholan]], the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] prisoner who had stolen the key from Ruger.<ref name="Fifth Time's the Charm">{{TORcite|type=faction|Fifth Time's the Charm|Belsavis}}</ref> After the force fields were deactivated, Imperial forces overran the guardpost and killed Ruger.<ref name="The Last of the Law">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Last of the Law|Belsavis}}</ref>
{{EndGame}}

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
When Master [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Korum]]'s forces breached [[Vault K-66]], a Rakatan vault in Minimum Security, they released ancient Rakatan war droids that resisted Imperial attempts to control them; Korum lost thirty men trying to take control of the droids with [[Computer spike/Legends|computer spikes]] before Imperial forces were successful.<ref name="Catalyzing the Conversion">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Catalyzing the Conversation|Belsavis}}</ref> One of the prisoners released by the Empire was the Sith Lord [[Ferrid]], who had been captured during the previous war. He recruited Imperial forces to raid [[Republic Guardpost Alpha]], as he suspected they were hiding something valuable; the raid yielded information on the prison schematics and hidden inmates.<ref name="Republic Secrets">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Republic Secrets|Belsavis}}</ref>

A group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] escapees raided the Republic supply depot in Minimum Security and made off with a large number of supplies, including the [[Motivator/Legends|motivator]] coils that Officer [[Brad Narong]] needed to fix a host of damaged warden droids. Fortunately for Narong, he was able to recruit Republic reinforcements that attacked the Mandalorian camps in the [[Mercenary Containment Cells]], destroying the turrets that used the stolen motivator coils.<ref name="For Want of a Droid">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|For Want of a Droid|Belsavis}}</ref> Amid the chaos, [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Firehawk (Kadas'sa'Nikto)|Firehawk]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency, enlisted military aid in locating Agent [[Mynock (SIS)|Mynock]], Firehawk's informant among the prisoners. Though Mynock was dead by the time that the Republic forces found him in the caves along the western cliffs of Minimum Security, Mynock's findings on Imperial traitors among the guards were retrieved from his body.<ref name="Jungle Flight">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Jungle Flight|Belsavis}}</ref>
{{EndGame}}

As the fighting spread to the High Security Section, the battle became a veritable free-for-all—the High Security Section was populated by violent members of alien species, and was the site of the illegal [[Project Noble Focus|Domination Experiments]]. Pioneered by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tudos]],<ref name="Domination">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Domination Experiments}}</ref> designed by a number of Republic scientists who were unaware of the tests' purposes,<ref name="A Lesson Is Learned">{{TORcite|type=heroic|A Lesson Is Learned|Belsavis}}</ref> and led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Neeya]],<ref name="Imperial Bonus">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Belsavis: Bonus Series|Belsavis}}</ref> the experiments—codenamed "Project Noble Focus"—saw the alien inhabitants of High Security pitted against each other in order to analyze the military capabilities of the species in monitored combat scenarios.<ref name="Domination" /> The aliens who participated were freed by Operations Group Four during the Imperial invasion, and quickly took controls of swaths of territory in High Security, attacking both the Empire and Republic and wiping out most of Operations Group Four.<ref name="Operations Group Four" />

{{GameDS}}
Captain Vandorn ordered Imperial reinforcements to strike back at the gangs; however, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] prisoners refused to back down after the initial attacks, leading the Empire to invade the [[Trandoshan vault|vault]] that they had overtaken. When the Trandoshan leader [[Ssevrek]] was defeated and collared by the Imperials, the rest of the Trandoshans fell into line.<ref name="Strength of Many">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Strength of Many}}</ref>
{{EndGame}}

{{GameLS}}
Republic forces under the command of Colonel [[Hauer]] at the [[Republic watchtower]] found themselves under attack by [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] prisoners, who stole [[Power core/Legends|power cores]] from warden droids and tried to use them to build bombs and blast their way out of their holding cells. Republic forces put a stop to the Rattataki's efforts, but Senator Tudos's involvement in the Domination Experiments was exposed by a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] prisoner named [[Nah Vee]].<ref name="Countdown to Jailbreak" /> Under the leadership of a criminal named [[Sulkhaz]], the [[Blood of Talath]] Rattataki tribe attacked the [[Republic detention compound|nearby detention compound]] that held [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] prisoners, though Republic forces drove back the Blood of Talath and rescued the Neimoidians. His role in the Domination Experiments revealed, Senator Tudos was arrested.<ref name="War Games" />
{{EndGame}}

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The Empire managed to seize control of the [[Power Generation Center]] in the northern High Security Section, wiping out [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Camren]]'s unit in the process. Furious at the death of his men, Camren came up with a plan to destroy the center's power relays with [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] charges, robbing the Empire of their prize.<ref name="Explosive Entrance">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Explosive Entrance|Belsavis}}</ref> During the fighting against the Rattataki, the aliens were able to capture a number of guard towers without communicating amongst themselves; however, Officer [[Serik]] used the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-5D1]] to determine that the Rattataki were using bird calls, allowing the Republic to regain the advantage.<ref name="Speaking Their Language">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Speaking Their Language}}</ref>
